# Heatmap



# Next plot for 1 km

```{r}
plot_df <-rand_results %>%
  left_join(., count, by = "rgn_key") %>% 
  mutate(
    country = countrycode::countrycode(
      rgn_key,
      origin = "iso3c",
      destination = "country.name"
    ),
    country = ifelse(is.na(country), rgn_key, country),
    facet_label = paste0(country, " (n = ", scales::comma(total_wind), ")")
  )

country_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(rgn_key) %>%
  summarise(
    max_abs_ses = max(abs(ses), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_abs_ses)) %>%
  pull(rgn_key)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_key = factor(rgn_key, levels = country_order),
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c(
        "Lower than random",
        "Not different from random",
        "Higher than random"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = ses, y = type, colour = category)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = -1.96, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "green") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -1.96, xmax = 1.96, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "grey") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1.96, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1.96, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.96, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ facet_label, ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Lower than random" = "#4DAF4A",
      "Not different from random" = "black",
      "Higher than random" = "#E41A1C"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized effect size (SES)",
    y = "Biodiversity feature",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
  )
```

# Histograms
```{r}
#rand_overlap<-list.files(here("output_data/Random_turbines"), pattern = "overlap", full.names = TRUE)
rand_count<-list.files(here("output_data/Random_turbines"), pattern = "turbines_count", full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
rand_count_bind<-rand_count %>% 
   map_dfr(~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
            select(-starts_with("...")) %>%
            mutate(source_file = basename(.x))) %>% 
  mutate(num_rand_wind_overlap = as.numeric(num_rand_wind_overlap))
```


```{r}
results<-read.csv(here("output_data/Paolo_results/Collated/Combined_count_by_country.csv"))
```

```{r}

results_compare <- rand_count_bind %>%
  mutate(
    num_rand_wind_overlap = readr::parse_number(as.character(num_rand_wind_overlap))
  ) %>%
  left_join(results, by = c("rgn_key", "type")) %>%
  mutate( overlap_wind2 = replace_na(overlap_wind, 0)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(., sub_rand_results, by = c("rgn_key", "type")) %>% 
  mutate(rm = ifelse(is.na(rand_mean) == T & is.na(overlap_wind) == T, "Remove", "Keep")) %>% 
  filter(rm == "Keep")

    
```

# One observed value per country/type

```{r}
obs_df <- results_compare %>%
  group_by(rgn_key, type) %>%
  summarise(
    observed = first(na.omit(overlap_wind2)),
    category = first(category),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```




```{r}
facet_lookup <- results_compare %>%
  distinct(rgn_key, baseline_wind_count) %>%
  mutate(
    country = countrycode::countrycode(rgn_key, "iso3c", "country.name"),
    country = ifelse(is.na(country), rgn_key, country),
    facet_label = paste0(country, "\n(n = ", scales::comma(as.numeric(baseline_wind_count)), ")")
  )

plot_df <- results_compare %>%
  left_join(facet_lookup, by = c("rgn_key", "baseline_wind_count"))

mean_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(rgn_key, type, facet_label) %>%
  summarise(rand_mean = mean(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

obs_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(rgn_key, type, facet_label) %>%
  summarise(
    observed = first(na.omit(overlap_wind2)),
    category = first(category),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

obs_df <- obs_df %>%
  mutate(
    category = recode(
      category,
      "Lower than random" = "Lower than random",
      "Not different from random" = "Random",
      "Higher than random" = "Higher than random"
    ),
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c(
        "Lower than random",
        "Random",
        "Higher than random"
      )
    )
  )


```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = num_rand_wind_overlap, y = type)) +
  geom_violin(
    fill = "grey85",
    alpha = 0.5,
    colour = "grey60",
    scale = "width",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
  data = mean_df,
  aes(x = rand_mean, y = type, shape = "Random mean"),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  colour = "black",
  size = 2.8
) +
geom_point(
  data = obs_df,
  aes(x = observed, y = type, colour = category, shape = "Observed overlap"),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 4,
  alpha = 0.5
) +
scale_shape_manual(
  values = c(
    "Random mean" = 16,
    "Observed overlap" = 17
  ),
  name = NULL
) +
  facet_wrap(~ facet_label, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Lower than random" = "#009E73",
      "Random" = "grey35",
      "Higher than random" = "#D55E00" 
    ),
    name = "Observed overlap"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of overlapping offshore wind structures",
    y = "Biodiversity feature"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  guides(
  shape = guide_legend(order = 1),
  colour = guide_legend(order = 2,
                        override.aes = list(shape = 17, size = 4))
)
```
